senses.gloss: m.(b. h. צֹפֶה; צָפָה)watchman, seer, prophet, inspired man.—Pl. צוֹפִים, צוֹפִין.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:11">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="M01810"><he>מַנְצְפַ״ךְ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:13">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> <he>מאן אינון אילין צופין</he> who were those inspired ones? Bab.

<cite ref="Megillah 14a:10">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 1:1">I Sam. I, 1</cite> <he>רמתים צופים</he>) <he>אחד ממאתים צ׳ וכ׳</he> one of the two hundred prophets that prophesied in Israel.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:7">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 31:27">Prov. XXXI, 27</cite>) <he>בני ביתו … צ׳ היו וכ׳</he> the members of Abraham’s household were prophets, and she (Hagar) used to look at them.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:6">Num. R. s. 19</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 316">Yalk. Is. 316</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00667"><he>צָף</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="R00672"><he>צָפָה</he></cite>.
